Container.Name: feedstash
Container.Overview: Self-hosted feed reader and read-it-later stash. Follow RSS and Atom feeds in folders, and save links, snippets and screenshots from the browser, email or your phone. Sign in with a password, Google, or any OpenID Connect provider.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port the web app is served on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and uploaded images. Use a pool path like /mnt/cache/appdata/feedstash rather than /mnt/user/appdata: SQLite doesn't like the /mnt/user FUSE layer.

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: The address you open FeedStash at, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8672. Use both if you also reach it through a reverse proxy, comma separated, proxy first: https://feedstash.example.com,http://192.168.1.10:8672

Config.Name: PASSWORD_LOGIN
Config.Description: Accounts with a FeedStash password. The first visit asks you to create the admin account.

Config.Name: ALLOWED_EMAILS
Config.Description: Comma-separated emails that may sign in with Google or OIDC (* for anyone your provider lets through).

Config.Name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: Optional Google sign-in. Redirect URI: BASE_URL/auth/google/callback

Config.Name: OIDC_ISSUER
Config.Description: Optional OpenID Connect provider (Authentik, Authelia, Keycloak, Pocket ID...). Redirect URI: BASE_URL/auth/oidc/callback

Config.Name: OIDC_NAME
Config.Description: Shown on the button: Sign in with ...

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users).

Config.Name: REFRESH_INTERVAL_MINUTES
Config.Description: How often feeds are fetched (5 or more).

Config.Name: RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: Feed articles older than this are deleted (starred ones and the newest 50 per feed are kept).
